packageRules.description: Compose BOM alone, never bundled — it's the single most likely thing to break Roborazzi screenshot baselines (already happened once: M3 1.4.0 changed NavigationBarItem's active label color), needs its own PR + baseline re-record cycle.
AndroidX libraries grouped together (excluding Compose BOM, handled separately above).
Test-only dependencies grouped — lower risk, safe to bundle since they never affect the shipped app.

:updatechecker deliberately pins coroutines to 1.9.0 (lower version = fewer constraints on consumers) — never let Renovate bump it, that's a manual, deliberate decision documented in updatechecker/README.md.
AGP/Gradle wrapper/Kotlin/KSP major version bumps need manual verification (see docs/adr/0002) — auto-merge is never appropriate here even if CI passes.
